title: Cube Chain 2048
description: Aim and fire bouncing 3D numbered cubes down a physics runway—collide matching blocks to trigger bouncy chain-reaction merges all the way past 2048.
controls: Hold and drag horizontally to aim your cube along the lane, then release to launch it into matching numbered cubes.

zh-CN.title: 3D 方块 2048
zh-CN.description: 爆款物理弹射合成 2048：拉线发射 Q 弹 3D 数字方块，碰撞相同数字触发连环弹跳合成暴击，根本停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕左右滑动瞄准发射位置，松手弹射方块撞击相同数字方块触发连锁升级合成。
